shop.general: Revenue and sales mean the amount of completed orders only; refunded and cancelled orders are not revenue.

orders.status.description: One of completed, refunded or cancelled

cases.question: How many employees are there?

expect.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees

cases.question: What is the average salary?

expect.sql: SELECT AVG(salary) FROM employees

cases.question: What is the average salary by department?

expect.sql: SELECT department, AVG(salary) FROM employees GROUP BY 1

cases.question: Which department has the highest average salary?

expect.sql: SELECT department FROM employees GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY AVG(salary) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: How many employees work in each location?

expect.sql: SELECT location, COUNT(*) FROM employees GROUP BY 1

cases.question: What is the highest salary?

expect.sql: SELECT MAX(salary) FROM employees

cases.question: What is the lowest salary in the Engineering department?

expect.sql: SELECT MIN(salary) FROM employees WHERE department = 'Engineering'

cases.question: What is the average performance score in each department?

expect.sql: SELECT department, AVG(performance_score) FROM employees GROUP BY 1

cases.question: How many people were hired in each year?

expect.sql: SELECT CAST(year(CAST(hire_date AS DATE)) AS VARCHAR), COUNT(*) FROM employees GROUP BY 1

cases.question: How many employees work remotely?

expect.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees WHERE location = 'Remote'

cases.question: Which department has the best average performance score?

expect.sql: SELECT department FROM employees GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY AVG(performance_score) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: How many employees earn more than 100,000?

expect.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees WHERE salary > 100000

cases.question: What is the total payroll, the sum of all salaries?

expect.sql: SELECT SUM(salary) FROM employees

cases.question: What is the total salary cost per department?

expect.sql: SELECT department, SUM(salary) FROM employees GROUP BY 1

cases.question: How many distinct job titles are there?

expect.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT job_title) FROM employees

cases.question: What is the total amount of completed orders?

expect.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed'

cases.question: How many orders are there in each status?

expect.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY 1

cases.question: What is the total amount of completed orders by category?

expect.sql: SELECT category, SUM(amount) FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY 1

cases.question: Which category has the highest total amount of completed orders?

expect.sql: SELECT category FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: What is the average order amount in each region, across all orders?

expect.sql: SELECT region, AVG(amount) FROM orders GROUP BY 1

cases.question: What share of all orders were refunded?

expect.sql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'refunded' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) FROM orders

cases.question: How many customers are in each segment?

expect.sql: SELECT segment, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY 1

cases.question: What is the total amount of completed orders for each customer segment?

expect.sql: SELECT c.segment, SUM(o.amount) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY 1

cases.question: Customers from which country placed the most orders?

expect.sql: SELECT c.country FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: What is the average amount of a completed order?

expect.sql: SELECT AVG(amount) FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed'

cases.question: What is the largest single order amount?

expect.sql: SELECT MAX(amount) FROM orders

cases.question: On average, how many orders has each customer who ordered placed?

expect.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders

cases.question: How many cancelled orders are there in each region?

expect.sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' GROUP BY 1

cases.question: Which customer has spent the most on completed orders?

expect.sql: SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: What is our total revenue?

expect.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed'

cases.question: What are total sales by region?

expect.sql: SELECT region, SUM(amount) FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY 1

cases.question: Does salary really differ between departments, or could the differences be chance?

expect.sql: SELECT department, salary FROM employees

cases.question: Is the salary difference between Remote and New York employees statistically significant?

expect.sql: SELECT location, salary FROM employees WHERE location IN ('Remote', 'New York')

cases.question: Is salary significantly correlated with performance score?

expect.sql: SELECT salary, performance_score FROM employees

cases.question: Is order status associated with region, or is any pattern just chance?

expect.sql: SELECT region, status FROM orders

cases.question: Do completed order amounts differ significantly between customer segments?

expect.sql: SELECT c.segment, o.amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed'
